statuses.matched: Representative behavior exists on both sides under the stated evidence boundary.
statuses.pliego-differentiator: PliegoCSS supplies a verified product capability outside Tailwind's utility-generation contract.
statuses.tailwind-advantage: Tailwind has materially broader or easier production behavior today.
statuses.different-by-design: The products intentionally solve the concern through different contracts; direct parity is not the goal.
statuses.open-gap: Required PliegoCSS 0.1.0 evidence or implementation is incomplete.

dimensions.tailwind: The pinned CLI generates the complete five-view fixture from visible class tokens.
dimensions.pliego: Gate B compiles all 44 class attributes, 302 occurrences, 90 unique concrete tokens, and all eight tracked variants.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve the fixture as a regression vector; do not infer full catalog parity.

dimensions.tailwind: Tailwind documents a broad production catalog across layout, typography, effects, filters, tables, transforms, interactivity, SVG, and accessibility.
dimensions.pliego: The generated catalog is intentionally compact and covers the selected typed families plus arbitrary declarations.
dimensions.nextAction: Add families only when representative applications or audit evidence require them; do not chase raw catalog parity.

dimensions.tailwind: Responsive and state variants are first-class authoring concepts.
dimensions.pliego: The matched fixture proves sm/md/lg, hover, focus, focus-visible, placeholder, and disabled; additional typed dimensions include theme, motion, contrast, ARIA/data, direction, containers, and layers.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain typed normalization and conflict contracts while expanding only evidence-backed variants.

dimensions.tailwind: Arbitrary values, properties, and variants provide escape hatches within utility markup.
dimensions.pliego: Parsed arbitrary values, one arbitrary declaration, custom properties, and bounded &[...] selector transforms preserve access to real CSS while rejecting unsafe/ambiguous shapes.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep the bounded grammar and improve only gaps demonstrated by real applications.

dimensions.tailwind: CSS-first @theme variables define utility namespaces and can be shared as CSS.
dimensions.pliego: Typed TOML and DTCG Resolver inputs produce versioned theme identity, a canonical token graph, and a Cargo build bridge.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve CSS interoperability while stabilizing the DTCG adapter with hosted portability evidence.

dimensions.tailwind: Scans source files as plain text for complete class tokens and supports explicit source registration.
dimensions.pliego: Validates visible Rust macro literals or consumes explicit typed adapter manifests; it refuses to infer framework ownership from filenames/text alone.
dimensions.nextAction: Add typed adapters for representative non-Rust hosts instead of a certainty-claiming generic dynamic scanner.

dimensions.tailwind: Ships Preflight as part of its normal full import.
dimensions.pliego: Emits no reset; current benchmark comparisons correctly use Tailwind no-preflight as the primary baseline.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep the external-reset policy explicit or add a separately versioned/measured optional reset; never fold it silently into output.

dimensions.tailwind: Pinned no-preflight complete fixture median is 204.826 ms across 30 fresh processes on the frozen host.
dimensions.pliego: Matched complete fixture median is 37.894 ms on the same frozen methodology, with one visible process outlier.
dimensions.nextAction: Treat this as fixture evidence, not a universal speed claim; add representative-app cold/incremental/no-op and memory measurements.

dimensions.tailwind: No-preflight fixture emits 8,618 raw / 2,327 gzip CSS bytes and 3,833 gzip transfer bytes with source utility classes.
dimensions.pliego: Matched fixture emits 10,463 raw / 2,049 gzip CSS bytes and 3,550 gzip transfer bytes after manifest class rewriting.
dimensions.nextAction: Report raw and compressed metrics together; preserve the caveat that Pliego raw CSS is larger.

dimensions.tailwind: Does not impose Rust procedural-macro compilation on non-Rust applications.
dimensions.pliego: Typed Rust authoring adds a large cold Cargo cost in the frozen Gate A measurement, while incremental medians are much smaller.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep standard-CSS audit useful without Rust adoption and measure/optimize cold dependency cost separately.

dimensions.tailwind: Complete-token extraction is productive but does not provide Pliego's typed property-slot conflict and theme-domain contract.
dimensions.pliego: Rejects unknown utilities/tokens, invalid domains, conflicts, impossible conditions, malformed arbitrary values, and cross-branch conflicts with stable diagnostics.
dimensions.nextAction: Add comparative diagnostic-quality evidence rather than relying on examples alone.

dimensions.tailwind: The compared core contract is utility generation, not a general integrity-bound CSS policy receipt.
dimensions.pliego: Accepts normal CSS for bounded compatibility, budget, accessibility, finding, and receipt workflows without requiring utility migration.
dimensions.nextAction: Close R0 standard-CSS classification and generic transform/minify output gaps before 0.1.0.

dimensions.tailwind: The compared CLI emits CSS but does not expose Pliego's source/config/output decision graph and canonical build/verification receipts.
dimensions.pliego: Versioned manifests, source maps, semantic/physical graphs, finding documents, and receipts integrity-bind controlled workflows.
dimensions.nextAction: Converge the R0 unified artifact and obtain hosted cross-OS evidence without relabeling existing schemas.

dimensions.tailwind: Automatic utility generation removes absent tokens, but the compared contract does not classify observed/unobserved/dead/unknown with ownership-backed route/package receipts.
dimensions.pliego: Budgets, typed ownership, exact reachability/observation evidence, retention, and conservative whole-StyleId pruning are implemented.
dimensions.nextAction: Close generic-CSS identities, hosted evidence, and final release replay.

dimensions.tailwind: Provides utilities and variants useful for accessible designs but does not certify their system-level correctness.
dimensions.pliego: Static policy distinguishes verified, unverified, manual-required, violation, and exception states for five bounded guard categories.
dimensions.nextAction: Add reviewed precision/recall plus browser/manual evidence; retain the explicit no-WCAG-certification limit.

dimensions.tailwind: The compared CLI has no equivalent closed proposal/authorization/change/verification receipt protocol.
dimensions.pliego: Exact low-risk edits, budgets, external authorization, idempotence, rollback, fixed runners, and canonical verification receipts are bounded by schemas.
dimensions.nextAction: Add real-incident efficacy and hosted signer/browser evidence before stable promotion.

dimensions.tailwind: Has a mature installed ecosystem and direct v4 authoring path.
dimensions.pliego: Can inventory bounded Tailwind/Sass/CSS Modules projects read-only, but reversible codemods and semantic migration outcomes are not implemented.
dimensions.nextAction: Deliver conservative reversible migration slices selected from representative applications, with visual and receipt evidence.

dimensions.tailwind: Has broad framework integrations, established documentation, and a production user ecosystem.
dimensions.pliego: Has a pinned PliegoRS path, plain HTML evidence, nineteen published Rust crates, and source-distributed editor clients, but a much smaller production ecosystem.
dimensions.nextAction: Prove Vite/plain HTML plus one additional typed adapter and publish installation compatibility rather than claiming ecosystem parity.

dimensions.tailwind: Published npm packages and documented install paths are available today.
dimensions.pliego: The exact-version 0.1.0-rc.2 crate graph, CLI, and LSP are published on crates.io and replayed with Rust 1.85; editor clients remain source-distributed candidates.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain registry replay on every candidate and publish versioned editor clients before claiming installation-surface parity.

dimensions.tailwind: Upstream documents a modern-browser compatibility floor and v4.3 behavior.
dimensions.pliego: Uses versioned targets and official-data policy, but complete CSS classification and hosted Chromium/Firefox/WebKit evidence remain incomplete.
dimensions.nextAction: Close the supported CSS corpus and hosted browser matrix while preserving explicit blocked/degraded decisions.

dimensions.tailwind: Provides responsive authoring but not Pliego's proposed causal browser diagnosis product.
dimensions.pliego: Current Chromium fixture checks validate known outputs; viewport-matrix failure localization is not implemented.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep experimental until a bounded evidence schema and reviewed precision corpus exist.

dimensions.tailwind: Supports custom styles, directives, and an ecosystem-oriented extension model.
dimensions.pliego: Defers unrestricted plugins to protect deterministic policy, schemas, and receipts; extensions must eventually be restricted and sandboxed.
dimensions.nextAction: Do not add unrestricted execution; design a versioned policy-pack/plugin boundary only after core release gates close.
